children: CVR Energy will begin using an Investor Presentation in meetings with investors and analysts highlighting refinery and fertilizer operations, capex plans and margin-capture priorities.
Investor Presentation (Sept 2026) furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and available on CVR Energy's Investor Relations website.
Petroleum: two Mid‑Con refineries totaling 206,500 bpd nameplate capacity; ~215,000 bpd total throughputs (TTM to 6/30/26).
Petroleum 2026 capex est. $119M–$130M; maintenance $79M–$87M, growth $40M–$43M; turnaround spend $15M–$20M.
Nitrogen fertilizer 2026 total capex est. $85M–$95M; maintenance $49M–$57M, growth $36M–$38M; turnaround expense $30M–$35M.
Margin-capture focus after 1H 2026 adjusted margin capture averaged 26%; actions include crude/feedstock optimization, RDU reversion and pursuing SREs for Wynnewood.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
